title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a dependent's bundle-member row moves no bare read across a restart, and a row-held base's own member is the base's
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96xkbCcbB1nF3xM9vBtrWwE)_ Fixes #34441 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (the ADR-0146 paragraph) and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` teach that a locale a dependent adds under a base's name is served only under its own `?package=`. This change makes `/published` and `/layers` hold to that for the canonical member of a base that ships only another member, before and after a restart, and makes a row-held base's own member the base's. No taught sentence moves. > **BREAKING**: one answer of `GET /meta/TYPE/NAME/published` naming no package moves from served to 404 (table below). Name the package (`?package=DEPENDENT&member=CANONICAL`) to read the row, as before. ADR-0087: `registered shipped-base-dependent-canonical-row-not-published`. Scope is the card as narrowed by the premise correction 6938023903 (claim 6938068147, branch amendment 6938092219). ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么：** 两处「同一请求、两个答案」对齐。(1) 基础包只在代码里发 `fr-FR`、依赖包存了规范成员 `en-US` 行时：`/published` 重启前会答依赖包那行，现在答 404；`/layers`（不点成员）重启后会 404，现在答基础包的 `fr-FR`。两扇门都和「没有依赖包那行」时一样，重启前后一致。(2) 基础包和依赖包都以存储行持有同一成员（如 `en-US`）时：不带包的读取、`/layers`、执行面从 409 点名两者，改为答基础包的行，和基础包在代码里发布时一样。 - **为什么改：** #28802 R2：依赖包追加的成员只在它自己的 `?package=` 下服务，不带包的读取看基础包。(1) 是层读把依赖包那行误报为基础包的「孤儿行」，而 `/published` 读的正是 overlay 层；重启后水合行占了注册表的裸名槽位，代码层读不到基础包的成员。(2) 是行持有判定没看依赖关系，把追加当成了第二个持有者。 - **风险与回滚：** 只动 metadata-protocol 的读取路径，不动写入。`/published` 那一格是收窄（200→404），已登记 ADR-0087 条目（新增一个 `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic` 文件），所以本 PR 走 Tier H。其余两格是把拒绝改成服务基础包自己的内容。回滚即还原本 PR。 - **先看：** `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` 的孤儿判定（加了 `isWantedMember(code)`）和代码层兜底；`protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 的 `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`（拆出 `rowHeldBaseJudgment`，新增「基础包在该成员也有行」一臂）。 - **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts -t "cell 1|S2,"`，预期 6 个用例全绿（cell 1 两个注册序，S2 四个）。 - **需要你做的：** 本 PR 新增 spec 迁移条目（Tier H），请在审核席核过后批准合入。 ## What changes - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` (`getMetaItemLayered`) - **Orphan arm (cell 1, before a restart).** The #28409 orphan report now requires the code layer to be the member the read addresses (`isWantedMember(code)`). Naming no member, a bundle whose base ships no canonical member takes the base's other member as its code layer; a dependent's canonical row is then the dependent's addition, not a row the base's document shadows. Reported as an orphan it was `overlay`, which `/published` serves. - **Code layer naming no member (cell 1, after a restart).** When the registry's bare slot answered a hydrated stored row (dropped as no artifact read, #21059), the code layer falls back to the artifact the bare name reads, the base's shipped member, as before the hydration. A named member and the bare action read are untouched. - **Layered door refusal (cell 2).** `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` no longer refuses two row holders of a member when one is the base and the other rows are bundle additions to it (`rowHeldBaseAddressOf`); beside a package-less row it still refuses (#33210). - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` - `rowHeldBaseAddressOf` is split: `rowHeldBaseJudgment` computes the row-grain base (unchanged rules: no shipper, readsByPackage, no environment item, every row at the member bound and not declined, no disabled holder, exactly one base by per-package dependency closure). A new arm answers the base at any member the base itself holds as a row beside one or more dependents' rows of it (cell 2). The existing arm (a member only additions hold) still moves a named non-canonical member only (the S1 guard). An optional `preread` takes rows already read. - `storedRowHoldersRefusal` (the item face's no-disabled arm) serves that base instead of refusing, when the base is among the holders at the member and no package-less row is beside them. - `rowHeldBaseJudgment` answers only for a bundled type (`overlayMemberValue` defined), judged before the rows are read: a type with no members has no bundle additions, so its row holders stay holders (L2 M1). Docblocks state the exception and that the writes naming no package still refuse (L2 S1, N3). - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: the contract docblock of `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` states the cell-2 exception and the writes' unchanged refusal (L2 S1). - `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.shipped-base-dependent-canonical-row-not-published.ts`: the ADR-0087 semantic entry for the `/published` narrowing. - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`: the new `lookupArtifactItem` site recorded, disposition `no` (the code layer: body and envelope are one artifact). - `.changeset/34441-shipped-base-canonical-member-one-answer.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec`. ### FROM → TO (every moved answer; runtime dispatcher, both registration orders) | Shape | Door (naming no package) | FROM (`main` 31096af83d) | TO | |:---|:---|:---|:---| | Cell 1: A ships `fr-FR` only, D (declares A) stores `en-US` | `/published` | before a restart 200 D's row; after 404 | 404 both (CONTROL: 404) | | same | `/layers` (no member) | before 200 A's `fr-FR`, `overlay` D's row; after 404 | 200 A's `fr-FR`, `overlay` null, both (CONTROL) | | same | plain read (no member), `?member=en-US`, `/layers?member=en-US`, execution read | A's `fr-FR` / 404 / 404 / A's `fr-FR`, both sides | unchanged | | Cell 2: A stores `en-US`, D stores `en-US` and `fr-FR`, no shipper | `?member=en-US`, `/layers?member=en-US`, execution read at `en-US` | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming A and D (execution: throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`) | 200 A's row | | same | naming no member (the canonical `en-US`): plain read, `/layers`, `/published`, execution read | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (execution: throws), both sides of a reboot | 200 A's row (`packageId` A; `/layers` effective and overlay A's row; `/published` A's row) | | Cell 2, A ships `en-US` (CONTROL) | `?member=en-US`, its `/layers`, execution read; plain read and execution read naming no member | 200 A's `en-US` | unchanged | | same | `/layers` and `/published` naming no member | overlay / served = D's row (#28409 shadowed-overlay report) | unchanged | | any | `?package=D&member=en-US` | D's row | unchanged | | Cell 2 rows, writes naming no package | save, delete, publish, draft, history | 409 naming A and D | unchanged (follow-up #34681) | | Type with no members (`dashboard`): A and D (declares A) both store rows, no shipper | plain read, `/layers`, `/published`, execution read | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming A and D | unchanged (pinned, `M1 guard`) | ## Tests `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, describe `[#32607 M1, M2]`: - **New `cell 1`** (both registration orders): with no D row, then with D's `en-US` row before a restart, then after a restart, the plain read, `?member=en-US`, `/layers` (effective and overlay), `/layers?member=en-US`, `/published` and both execution reads equal the CONTROL read on the same boot; `?package=D&member=en-US` serves D's row on both sides. - **`S2` flipped** (row-held cells): `?member=en-US` naming no package, `/layers?member=en-US` and the execution read serve A's row (`packageId` A) before and after a reboot, and `?package=D&member=en-US` serves D's; the shipped CONTROL cells assert the same answers. - **`M1 guard`** (L2 M1), both registration orders: a `dashboard` base A and dependent D (declares A) both store, no shipper; the plain read, `/layers`, `/published` and the execution read refuse `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming A and D before and after a reboot, and each `?package=` serves its own row. - **`S2`, doors naming no member** (L1 R1): the plain read, `/layers`, `/published` and the execution read naming no member, asserted for both holdings, both registration orders, before and after a reboot. All four serve A's `en-US`. They differ by holding only in the overlay layer and `/published`: over a row-held base that is A's own row; over a shipped base A holds no row and it is D's row, the #28409 shadowed-overlay report, unchanged from `main`. ## Acceptance notes - Narrowed acceptance (6938023903): `/published` before a restart and `/layers` after one give the CONTROL's answers, each pinned against the CONTROL across a restart; cell 2 resolved as the card states, pinned for both holdings. - Not moved: two dependents storing the same member over a base that holds none of it are still refused naming both (the base is not among the holders at the member); a package-less row beside two holders is still refused (#33210); a dependent's canonical row over a row-held base of another member is still served (the S1 pin). - The side reading in the premise check (`?package=D&member=en-US` with D holding nothing answers 409) is the ruled `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal (ADR-0150 D5, ruling 6917064203), not a defect. - Follow-up cards (filed by the seat): #34681, whether the writes naming no package (save, delete, publish, draft, history) follow the base in the cell-2 shape, where the read doors now serve the base's stack (L2 S1); #34682, `main`'s baseline in the cell-1 shape, where `/published` and `?member=en-US` answer 404 beside the plain read's 200 A's `fr-FR` (L2 ③). - Serial: PR #34347 also edits `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`; `git merge-tree` of this head against its branch and against PR #34238's is clean. ## Verification Final head `6acd3f1290` (merge base `origin/main` 31096af83d). Rounds since the first cut `258cbe15`: `d4500af04d` placed the code-layer fallback below `if (regItem !== undefined) code = regItem;` and recorded the call site; `1aff827bd5` has the item face's judge host hand back the active rows it already read (objectql #24371 one-read pins); `6fe5e956be` pins cell 2's doors naming no member (L1 R1); `6acd3f1290` keeps the row-held base judgment to bundled types, pins a non-bundled name as still refused, and states the read doors' exception and the writes' unchanged refusal in the docblocks and changeset (L2 M1, S1, S2, N1–N3). - At `6acd3f1290`: metadata-protocol full suite 23046 passed / 45 skipped (348 files, lock VERDICT 0); objectql `src/protocol*` 1189/1189; runtime `src/domains` 6628/6628 (221 files; served-stack 161/161); rest `src/meta*` 2213/2213; spec `src/migrations` 198/198; typecheck metadata-protocol exit 0 and runtime `check:test-typecheck` OK. - Derived gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` 97 derived, 97 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0. 93 ran after a full closure build at `d4500af04d`/`1aff827bd5`; the 4 the new `protocol.ts` path adds (`check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:facade-delegation-only`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:wildcard-fallthrough`) and the ADR-0087 and changeset gates ran at `6acd3f1290`. - Dogfood battery (narrowing arm), full, under the lock at `6acd3f1290`: 478 passed / 3 skipped files, 4055 passed / 68 skipped tests, VERDICT command-exit 0. - CI at `6acd3f1290`: 56 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed.
Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, metadata-protocol rebuilt, restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty) 1. Orphan guard off (`isWantedMember(code)` dropped): `cell 1` red in both orders. 2. Code-layer fallback off: `cell 1` red in both orders. 3. Item-face base arm off (`storedRowHoldersRefusal`): `S2` row-held red ×2. 4. Layered-door base arm off: `S2` row-held red ×2. 5. Shared-member arm off in `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`: `S2` row-held red ×2. Runs 1–5: 2 failed, 13 passed of the 15 cases in the M1/M2/S1/S2/cell 1 set. 6. Judge-host reuse off (the `1aff827bd5` line): objectql `protocol-meta.test.ts` red ×2 (`find` called 2 times, not 1), as CI read it at `d4500af04d`. 7. Cell-2 arm off (`atMember.has(base)` returns undefined): the S2 row-held cells red ×2 at the no-member doors; with the assertions relaxed, the same run measured the FROM: 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` on the plain read, `/layers`, `/published` and the execution read (throws), both orders, before and after a reboot. 8. Bundled-type guard off in `rowHeldBaseJudgment`: the `M1 guard` cells red ×2, nothing else. Log: area share `34441-ablation.log`.
